content_html:
Peru is a destination that truly has it all: ancient history, breathtaking landscapes, and one of the world’s most celebrated cuisines. If you want your experience to be unforgettable, you need more than just a plane ticket — you need a well-planned travel package.

Here’s how to build the perfect package for your dream trip to Peru with GT Peru Travel.

Define the Type of Experience You Want

Before requesting a quote, ask yourself:

  • Are you looking for adventure or relaxation?
  • Are you traveling as a couple, family, or with friends?
  • Do you prefer culture, nature, or gastronomy?

In Peru, you can combine:

  • History in Cusco
  • Wonders of the world like Machu Picchu
  • Sand dunes and oasis landscapes in Huacachina
  • Wildlife adventures in the Peruvian Amazon
  • Culinary experiences in Lima

Defining your travel style is the first step to creating a package tailored to you.

Choose the Best Time to Travel

Peru has two main seasons:

May to October (Dry Season)
Ideal for visiting Machu Picchu and trekking in the Andes.

November to March (Rainy Season)
Greener landscapes and fewer tourists.

Tip: If traveling during high season, book in advance to secure availability.

Select Accommodation and Transportation Carefully

A well-designed travel package should include:

Well-located hotel accommodations
Airport transfers
Comfortable tourist transportation
Train options to Machu Picchu

Comfort and logistics make the difference between a good trip and an extraordinary one.

Include Must-See Tours

Some essential tours to consider:

  • Cusco City Tour
  • Sacred Valley Tour
  • Machu Picchu Full-Day Experience
  • Rainbow Mountain
  • Lake Titicaca

A properly organized itinerary maximizes your time and helps avoid unnecessary expenses.

Plan with a Trusted Tour Operator

Choosing a reliable company guarantees:

Official entrance tickets
Certified professional guides
Personalized assistance
Safe and organized experiences

Travel with GT Peru Travel

With GT Peru Travel, you can design a fully customized Peru travel package that fits your interests, schedule, and budget.

From the mystical Andes to the Amazon rainforest and coastal cities, we take care of every detail so you can simply enjoy the journey.

Plan ahead, choose the right travel partner, and get ready to experience a trip you will remember for a lifetime.

Contact GT Peru Travel today and start planning your Peruvian adventure with confidence.
